scope: Production Desktop and authenticated Web with real Host reads and controlled HTTP response delivery
checks: Desktop chooses a real file, inserts the shared icon and short name, and keeps editing focus
same-name files receive the shortest distinguishing directories
click opens existing preview with actual file bytes
native same-root cross-thread paste reissues target identity and persists it
different-root native paste preserves the atom and marks it for reselection
authenticated Web uses the same candidate and file atom components
a valid file alone enables the actual public Composer send action
delayed candidate confirmation blocks mouse and direct form submission until the correct atom is inserted
keyboard file-tree action inserts the same atom beside existing content and returns editing focus
file-tree open and reference resolution share the submission barrier from their first asynchronous operation
Tab filtering, Enter selection, atomic deletion and native Undo preserve file identity
Enter on a keyboard-selected file opens its preview
preview reference action preserves existing input and restores editing focus
native Chinese composition pauses candidates and commits the complete spaced/hash filename identity
native input history restores the published file atom and its position
published file renders and previews; whole-message copy restores a structured file atom
controlled request-level business and protocol errors have distinct UI states and block sending without claiming a connection failure
actual send rejects a deleted file, marks its atom, preserves the draft and creates no message or execution
deferred old success cannot clear a send rejection; a new post-rejection check can confirm the restored file
narrow touch long-press exposes the full path and 44px actions without opening a preview

method.insertion: Native selection with deferred real Host replies; disabled mouse send and direct form submit both required to make zero send RPC attempts; unexpected attempts are blocked by the fixture.
method.classification: Controlled business root_unavailable and malformed response DTO at the actual availability entry, followed by a real successful retry. Unit owner separately verifies transport failures.
method.rejectionRace: Defer a real available response, delete its real file, submit to Core, assert actual rejection and draft preservation, deliver old success, assert unavailable remains; restore file and assert a new check can clear it.

limitations: Controlled delivery is deterministic race validation, not a performance benchmark.
Touch and narrow viewport are browser emulation, not real mobile hardware.
Existing unrelated file preview/navigation baseline failures and the original R3 model-behavior failure are not reclassified.
